claims.claim: Pure constructors and validators produce a deterministic, content-addressed Evidence Construct bound to one exact Brief, audit profile, successful baseline acquisition set, and 1–64 exact Pass-1 claims.
Pass 1 grounds challenge targets, requires exact counter-request target coverage, enforces request bounds and the 64-observation worst-case capacity, and exposes no refinement API.

Both stages reject failed, missing, duplicate, foreign, or substituted acquisition material; successful zero-observation attempts are admitted. Pass 2 accepts only the precommitted counter requests and checks the combined unique observation corpus.
Pass 2 requires nine ordered audit results with exact bounded references and complete challenge coverage, and reconciles every Pass-1 and final claim without duplicate or many-to-one mappings.

The final record is revalidated against the same Brief and profile, restricted to admitted observation identities, and checked for consistency between its outcome and Brain-authored BLOCKING dispositions. The protocol performs no external I/O or persistence.

Focused regressions cover both closures, zero-observation success, acquisition rejection, target and request coverage, corpus capacity, audit coverage, claim reconciliation, source restriction, blocker consistency, untrusted text containment, and the absence of external-operation imports.
